crossRefs.note: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
The Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
The prophet came near to the king of Israel, and said to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and mark, and see what you do…

parallels.note: The Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: The Philistines made a another raid in the valley.
translations.bsb: Once again the Philistines raided the valley.
translations.kjv: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
translations.asv: And the Philistines yet again made a raid in the valley.
